content.text: I’ve completed the implementation. The local server needs to stay attached in this environment, but the game itself is ready in `index.html`.

Built a complete mobile fantasy boss-fighting game in `index.html`.

Features include:
- Touch joystick and action buttons
- Melee attacks, dash, and area skill
- Boss health bars and projectile attacks
- Minion enemies and XP progression
- Three upgrade choices
- Four boss encounters
- Victory and defeat states
- Responsive portrait and landscape design
